name: BFR KiCad Library Manager
description: All-in-one library manager, JLCPCB manufacturing suite, and LCSC part assigner for KiCad
description_full:
BFR KiCad Library Manager is a comprehensive KiCad plugin that combines library management with JLCPCB manufacturing integration.

Features:
- Import component ZIPs from Samacsys, Snapeda, UltraLibrarian, Octopart, EasyEDA/LCSC
- Auto-classify components into organized bfr_* libraries
- LCSC/JLCPCB metadata enrichment (no API key needed)
- Sort Later tab for organizing bfr_master
- External library bulk importer
- Auto-Init project library tables
- JLCPCB Production Bridge:
  - Live JLCPCB part search with detailed specs (voltage, power, tolerance)
  - One-click LCSC assignment with metadata autopopulation
  - Auto-Assign LCSC by MPN cross-reference
  - Select Alike for bulk passive assignment
  - Gerber, Drill, BOM, CPL generation
  - Interactive HTML BOM integration
  - Schematic LCSC sync
- BFR logo silkscreen stamp
